defects.rationale: os.system is invoked with an f-string interpolating the untrusted 'filename' argument directly into a shell command, so input such as 'a.png; rm -rf /' executes arbitrary commands. Note: read_code was blocked, so line 4 is taken from the inline source snippet.

The os.system return code is returned without being checked against 0, so a failed conversion is indistinguishable from success at the call site. Based on inline snippet only; file read evidence unavailable.
